Step 1: Extract POI from OSM (amenity, education, health, religion, shop tags). Step 2: Supplement with official facility registers (UBEC for schools; FMOH for health). Step 3: Add field-verified POI from community surveys. Step 4: Classify into project POI classes (LKP_POIClasses.csv). Step 5: Remove duplicates (same facility from multiple sources). Step 6: Assign POI_ID. Step 7: Spatially validate against G01/G02.

POI completeness depends heavily on source. OSM is strong for religious buildings and markets in urban areas but weak for rural health posts and schools. Official registers (UBEC/FMOH) are more complete for formal facilities but may not capture informal or private facilities. Field survey fills gaps for project communities. Deduplication is critical when combining sources — same facility may appear in all three.
